summary: Off-registry dependency fetched from mutable GitHub raw URL
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `node-ac2` as `https://github.com/GamerD11/ping_test/raw/main/node-ac2.tgz` instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches that tarball directly from a personal GitHub repository's mutable `main` branch and installs it, running any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched archive, with no version pin and no integrity check. The shipped package itself contains no functional code — the manifest line is the entire install-time payload, so whoever controls the referenced GitHub repository controls code executed on every installer's machine at install time. The repository name `ping_test` under a personal account is unrelated to the package's stated `Account utility library` purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
